sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Actually viewed native and nearest4: smiling woman turned over her screen-right shoulder, brown brushed-back hair with low gathered braid trailing down screen-left, separate brown brows, clean lip/chin and open tooth-showing smile. Large soft olive-grey beret tilted screen left, olive-grey high pointed-collar coat fastened by one round brown button, muted red neck scarf tucked within collar, shoulder/back three-quarter silhouette. Retain hairstyle/braid, hat tilt, red scarf/coat/button and smiling expression adapted to one mascot mouth, original crop/light/full cream-grey backing; broad short throat fits coat without human long neck. Fine teeth, beret weave and button detail unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Actually viewed native and nearest4: woman slight screen-left three-quarter with light brown short front wave and swept-back hair gathered low at back, separate light brown brows and clean lip/chin, closed slight smile. Big dark olive beret with raised seam on screen right, light olive broad pointed-lapel outer shirt/jacket over dark green inner collar. Keep beret/hair and distinct light/dark clothes, shoulder/chest crop/light/full cream-grey backing; short broad mascot transition sits naturally in open collar. Small seam/inner fastener detail unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Actually viewed native and nearest4: nearly frontal woman with brown shoulder-length waved hair, separate brown brows, clean lip/chin and serious closed mouth. Broad rounded dark navy peaked cap with raised pale rim and gold geometric meander band above dark visor; navy broad-lapel coat, light grey pointed shirt and narrow dark tie, two small round gold lapel buttons. Preserve cap shape/gold band, hair length and shoulder curls, clothing/paired buttons, crop/light/full cream-grey backing; broad short mascot throat fits shirt collar. Exact small geometric turns and tie fastening are source pixel limits.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Actually viewed native and nearest4: frontal woman with brown straight jaw-length inward-curving bob and separate brown brows, bare lip/chin, small closed smile. Soft dark green beret tilted toward screen left, forest-green broad pointed collar jacket with shoulder seam/epaulette-like tab over cream open pointed shirt. Keep distinct bob/beret and cream open shirt/green outerwear, original crop/light/full cream-grey backing; fit open collar to compact broad mascot throat. Tiny shoulder seam/cloth texture unreadable.
